critical_code_review_comments: Minor: Total-vs-(perLb*lbs) display can be up to ~$0.11 off due to rounding perLb display before multiplication. Only cosmetic; users comparing shown per-lb × qty may notice a few cents. Consider computing total from unrounded per-lb (already done) but also displaying perLb at 3 decimals or adding a subtle note — low priority.

The '+$1.00/lb' badge sits flush with the variant label 'Container - 1 lb+$1.00/lb' (no space). Cosmetic only; consider a small gap or wrap in a separate span (it is already separate, but text_content concatenates in tests — visual spacing looks fine in screenshot).
context_for_next_testing_agent: cd-beef base per-lb = $6.66 (from pricing[size_lb=6]=$39.96). Each qty-increase step for meals = 6 lb (qtyStep=6). Tier rates confirmed: {12:0.05, 24:0.10, 36:0.15}. Container upcharge = $1.00/lb added AFTER tier discount. Menu modal is rendered by BoxBuilder via activeProductId → ProductDetailModal; both card body click and + button call onOpenProduct.
rca of the issue: User's claim that 'tier pricing is gone' is NOT reproducible. The per-lb price on /product/cd-beef with Freezer Pouch - 1 lb decreases strictly at 12/24/36 lb by 5%/10%/15% as designed. Possible user-side cause: (a) user may have been viewing a Monthly Bundle (isMonthlyBundle→bulkRate forced to 0), or (b) user only viewed the 'From $X.XX /lb' initial state at qty=0 which correctly shows the base per-lb (no tier applied until qty > 0), or (c) user changed variant which re-uses same tier and can look unchanged when lbs is under 12. No code fix required.
